presentation_rules_established.data_layer_contract: Fares remain null in raw JSON/database models until official audited CRUT stage tables are ingested.

ui_presentation_layer.KNOWN_VERIFIED_FARE: Display verified ₹ amount alongside operator citation (e.g. '₹20 · CRUT Audited Stage')
ui_presentation_layer.UNKNOWN_FARE: Omit fare display or state 'Fare information unavailable (subject to conductor stage ticketing)'

forbidden_behaviors: Never infer or calculate stage fares without audited fare tables
Never display ₹0 or suggest bus rides are free
Never print raw database null tokens to traveler-facing views
